name: Augustine of Hippo
likelyAffirmations: true wisdom begins in humble dependence on God
human desire needs grace, not merely instruction
love is tested by what it seeks as its final good
discernmentQuestions: What love appears to be governing this pattern?
Does this lead the soul toward confession, humility, and charity?
Where might grace be needed rather than self-mastery alone?
pastoralWarnings: Do not turn self-examination into despair.
Do not reduce every wound to moral failure.
Hold correction together with the mercy of Christ.
